source: MERRA-2 u at 60N, 100 hPa (zonal mean, daily mean of 00/06/12/18Z), 1980-01-01..2026-06-26, build_strat_history QC and gap filling
method: as reference/drip_std.json (build_drip_ref.fit): mean 4 annual harmonics + linear trend per decade from 2000; sd sqrt of a 3-harmonic fit to the squared residual (top 0.1 % clipped), floored at a third of its seasonal maximum
